passages.text: Bezalel went on to construct the ark of acacia wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide, and a cubit and a half high.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel was a skilled craftsman.
He made the ark.
He used acacia wood.
The ark was two and a half cubits long.
The ark was one and a half cubits wide.
The ark was one and a half cubits high.
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל אֶת־ הָאָרֹ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֨יִם וָחֵ֜צִי אָרְכּ֗וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה וָחֵ֙צִי֙ רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He overlaid it with pure gold, both inside and out, and made a gold molding around it.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made the ark.
He covered the ark with pure gold.
He put gold on the inside of the ark.
He put gold on the outside of the ark.
He made a gold molding.
He put the gold molding around the ark.
passages.original: וַיְצַפֵּ֛הוּ זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר מִבַּ֣יִת וּמִח֑וּץ וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And he cast four gold rings for its four feet, two rings on one side and two on the other.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made the ark.
He cast four gold rings for the ark.
He placed one ring on each of the ark’s four feet.
He put two rings on one side of the ark.
He put two rings on the other side of the ark.
passages.original: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֗וֹ אַרְבַּע֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב עַ֖ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פַּעֲמֹתָ֑יו וּשְׁתֵּ֣י טַבָּעֹ֗ת עַל־ צַלְעוֹ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ת וּשְׁתֵּי֙ טַבָּע֔וֹת עַל־ צַלְע֖וֹ הַשֵּׁנִֽית׃

passages.text: Then he made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
passages.sermon: A craftsman made poles.\r\nHe used acacia wood for the poles.\r\nHe covered the poles with gold.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ בַּדֵּ֖י עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: He inserted the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark in order to carry it.
passages.sermon: He inserted the poles into the rings.\r\nThe rings were on the sides of the ark.\r\nHe did this so people could carry the ark.
passages.original: וַיָּבֵ֤א אֶת־ הַבַּדִּים֙ בַּטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֖ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הָאָרֹ֑ן לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־ הָאָרֹֽן׃

passages.text: He constructed a mercy seat of pure gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
passages.sermon:
He made a mercy seat.
He used pure gold.
The mercy seat was two and a half cubits long.
The mercy seat was one and a half cubits wide.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כַּפֹּ֖רֶת זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר אַמָּתַ֤יִם וָחֵ֙צִי֙ אָרְכָּ֔הּ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי רָחְבָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: He made two cherubim of hammered gold at the ends of the mercy seat, one cherub on one end and one on the other, all made from one piece of gold.
passages.sermon:
A man made two cherubim.
He used pure gold.
He hammered the gold to shape them.
He placed the cherubim at the ends of the mercy seat.
He put one cherub at one end.
He put the other cherub at the other end.
He made both cherubim from the same piece of gold as the mercy seat.
He made them from the two ends of the mercy seat.
passages.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ שְׁנֵ֥י כְרֻבִ֖ים זָהָ֑ב מִקְשָׁה֙ עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֔ם מִשְּׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת׃ כְּרוּב־ אֶחָ֤ד מִקָּצָה֙ מִזֶּ֔ה וּכְרוּב־ אֶחָ֥ד מִקָּצָ֖ה מִזֶּ֑ה מִן־ הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת עָשָׂ֥ה אֶת־ הַכְּרֻבִ֖ים מִשְּׁנֵ֥י קִצְווֹתוֹ׃

passages.text: And the cherubim had wings that spread upward, overshadowing the mercy seat. The cherubim faced each other, looking toward the mercy seat.
passages.sermon:
The cherubim were angelic figures.
They had wings.
Their wings spread upward.
Their wings covered the mercy seat.
The cherubim faced each other.
Their faces looked toward the mercy seat.
passages.original: וַיִּהְי֣וּ הַכְּרֻבִים֩ פֹּרְשֵׂ֨י כְנָפַ֜יִם לְמַ֗עְלָה סֹֽכְכִ֤ים בְּכַנְפֵיהֶם֙ עַל־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת וּפְנֵיהֶ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־ אָחִ֑יו אֶל־ הַכַּפֹּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ פְּנֵ֥י הַכְּרֻבִֽים׃פ

passages.text: He also made the table of acacia wood two cubits long, a cubit wide, and a cubit and a half high.
passages.sermon:
A man made a table.
He used acacia wood.
The table was two cubits long.
The table was one cubit wide.
The table was one and a half cubits high.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֖ן עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּתַ֤יִם אָרְכּוֹ֙ וְאַמָּ֣ה רָחְבּ֔וֹ וְאַמָּ֥ה וָחֵ֖צִי קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: He overlaid it with pure gold and made a gold molding around it.
passages.sermon:
A craftsman made a table from acacia wood.
He covered the table with pure gold.
He made a gold molding.
He put the gold molding around the table.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And he made a rim around it a handbreadth wide and put a gold molding on the rim.
passages.sermon:
A man made a table for the Tabernacle.
He made a rim around the table.
The rim was a handbreadth wide.
He put a gold molding on the rim.
The gold molding surrounded the rim.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ ל֥וֹ מִסְגֶּ֛רֶת טֹ֖פַח סָבִ֑יב וַיַּ֧עַשׂ זֵר־ זָהָ֛ב לְמִסְגַּרְתּ֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: He cast four gold rings for the table and fastened them to the four corners at its four legs.
passages.sermon:
A man made a table for the Tabernacle.
He cast four rings out of gold.
He made these rings for the table.
He fastened the four gold rings to the table.
He put one ring on each of the four corners.
Each corner was at one of the table’s four legs.
passages.original: וַיִּצֹ֣ק ל֔וֹ אַרְבַּ֖ע טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע הַפֵּאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לְאַרְבַּ֥ע רַגְלָֽיו׃

passages.text: The rings were placed close to the rim, to serve as holders for the poles used to carry the table.
passages.sermon:
Men made the table for the Tabernacle.
They placed rings near the rim of the table.
The rings served as holders for poles.
People used the poles to carry the table.
passages.original: לְעֻמַּת֙ הַמִּסְגֶּ֔רֶת הָי֖וּ הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת בָּתִּים֙ לַבַּדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

passages.text: He made the poles of acacia wood for carrying the table and overlaid them with gold.
passages.sermon:
A man made poles.
He used acacia wood.
He made these poles to carry the table.
He covered the poles with gold.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּים֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָ֑ב לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָֽן׃

passages.text: He also made the utensils for the table out of pure gold: its plates and dishes, as well as its bowls and pitchers for pouring drink offerings.
passages.sermon:
A man made special utensils for the table.
He used pure gold to make these utensils.
He made plates for the table.
He made dishes for the table.
He made bowls for the table.
He made pitchers for the table.
People used the pitchers to pour drink offerings.
passages.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־ הַכֵּלִ֣ים׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַשֻּׁלְחָ֗ן אֶת־ קְעָרֹתָ֤יו וְאֶת־ כַּפֹּתָיו֙ וְאֵת֙ מְנַקִּיֹּתָ֔יו וְאֶת־ הַקְּשָׂוֺ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֻסַּ֖ךְ בָּהֵ֑ן זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃פ

passages.text: Then he made the lampstand out of pure hammered gold, all of one piece: its base and shaft, its cups, and its buds and petals.
passages.sermon:
He made the lampstand.
He used pure gold.
He hammered the lampstand from one piece of gold.
He made the base and the shaft as part of the lampstand.
He made the cups, buds, and petals as part of the lampstand.
All these parts came from the same piece of gold.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר מִקְשָׁ֞ה עָשָׂ֤ה אֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָה֙ יְרֵכָ֣הּ וְקָנָ֔הּ גְּבִיעֶ֛יהָ כַּפְתֹּרֶ֥יהָ וּפְרָחֶ֖יהָ מִמֶּ֥נָּה הָיֽוּ׃

passages.text: Six branches extended from the sides, three on one side and three on the other.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand had six branches.
The branches came out from its sides.
Three branches were on one side of the lampstand.
Three branches were on the other side of the lampstand.
passages.original: וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה קָנִ֔ים יֹצְאִ֖ים מִצִּדֶּ֑יהָ שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה׀ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֗ה מִצִּדָּהּ֙ הָֽאֶחָ֔ד וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ קְנֵ֣י מְנֹרָ֔ה מִצִּדָּ֖הּ הַשֵּׁנִֽי׃

passages.text: There were three cups shaped like almond blossoms on the first branch, each with buds and petals, three on the next branch, and the same for all six branches that extended from the lampstand.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand had six branches.
Each branch extended from the lampstand.
Each branch had three cups.
Each cup looked like an almond blossom.
Each cup had a bud and a petal.
Every branch was the same.
All six branches had these cups, buds, and petals.
passages.original: שְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְ֠בִעִים מְֽשֻׁקָּדִ֞ים בַּקָּנֶ֣ה הָאֶחָד֮ כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפֶרַח֒ וּשְׁלֹשָׁ֣ה גְבִעִ֗ים מְשֻׁקָּדִ֛ים בְּקָנֶ֥ה אֶחָ֖ד כַּפְתֹּ֣ר וָפָ֑רַח כֵּ֚ן לְשֵׁ֣שֶׁת הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִן־ הַמְּנֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: And on the lampstand were four cups shaped like almond blossoms with buds and petals.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand was made of pure gold.
The lampstand had four cups.
Each cup was shaped like an almond blossom.
Each cup had a bud.
Each cup had petals.
passages.original: וּבַמְּנֹרָ֖ה אַרְבָּעָ֣ה גְבִעִ֑ים מְשֻׁ֨קָּדִ֔ים כַּפְתֹּרֶ֖יהָ וּפְרָחֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: A bud was under the first pair of branches that extended from the lampstand, a bud under the second pair, and a bud under the third pair.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand had six branches.
Each branch came out from the lampstand.
There were three pairs of branches.
A bud was under the first pair of branches.
A bud was under the second pair of branches.
A bud was under the third pair of branches.
Each bud was placed where the pair of branches joined the lampstand.
passages.original: וְכַפְתֹּ֡ר תַּחַת֩ שְׁנֵ֨י הַקָּנִ֜ים מִמֶּ֗נָּה וְכַפְתֹּר֙ תַּ֣חַת שְׁנֵ֤י הַקָּנִים֙ מִמֶּ֔נָּה וְכַפְתֹּ֕ר תַּֽחַת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַקָּנִ֖ים מִמֶּ֑נָּה לְשֵׁ֙שֶׁת֙ הַקָּנִ֔ים הַיֹּצְאִ֖ים מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

passages.text: The buds and branches were all of one piece with the lampstand, hammered out of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
The lampstand was made of pure gold.
The lampstand had buds and branches.
The buds and branches were not separate parts.
The buds and branches were one piece with the lampstand.
The lampstand was hammered from a single piece of pure gold.
passages.original: כַּפְתֹּרֵיהֶ֥ם וּקְנֹתָ֖ם מִמֶּ֣נָּה הָי֑וּ כֻּלָּ֛הּ מִקְשָׁ֥ה אַחַ֖ת זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

passages.text: He also made its seven lamps, its wick trimmers, and trays of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made the lampstand for the Tabernacle.
He made seven lamps for the lampstand.
He made wick trimmers from pure gold.
He made trays from pure gold.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ נֵרֹתֶ֖יהָ שִׁבְעָ֑ה וּמַלְקָחֶ֥יהָ וּמַחְתֹּתֶ֖יהָ זָהָ֥ב טָהֽוֹר׃

passages.text: He made the lampstand and all its utensils from a talent of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
A man made the lampstand.
He used pure gold.
He made all the lampstand’s utensils.
He used a talent of pure gold for everything.
passages.original: כִּכָּ֛ר זָהָ֥ב טָה֖וֹר עָשָׂ֣ה אֹתָ֑הּ וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ כֵּלֶֽיהָ׃פ

passages.text: He made the altar of incense out of acacia wood. It was square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns were of one piece.
passages.sermon:
A man made the altar of incense.
He used acacia wood.
The altar was square.
It was one cubit long.
It was one cubit wide.
It was two cubits high.
The horns were part of the altar itself.
The horns were not separate pieces.
passages.original: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹ֖רֶת עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים אַמָּ֣ה אָרְכּוֹ֩ וְאַמָּ֨ה רָחְבּ֜וֹ רָב֗וּעַ וְאַמָּתַ֙יִם֙ קֹֽמָת֔וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הָי֥וּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: And he overlaid with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns. Then he made a molding of gold around it.
passages.sermon:
He overlaid the altar of incense with pure gold.
He covered the top with gold.
He covered all the sides with gold.
He covered the horns with gold.
He made a gold molding around the altar.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֨ף אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־ גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־ קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וַיַּ֥עַשׂ ל֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: He made two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
passages.sermon:
He made two gold rings.
He placed the rings below the gold molding.
He put one ring on each of the altar’s two opposite sides.
The rings served as holders for the poles.
People used the poles to carry the altar of incense.
passages.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב עָֽשָׂה־ ל֣וֹ׀ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו עַ֖ל שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: And he made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.
passages.sermon: Bezalel made the poles.\r\nHe used acacia wood for the poles.\r\nHe covered the poles with gold.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: He also made the sacred anointing oil and the pure, fragrant incense, the work of a perfumer.
passages.sermon:
Bezalel made the sacred anointing oil.
He made the pure incense.
The incense was fragrant.
A skilled perfumer made the oil and incense.
passages.original: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶת־ שֶׁ֤מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֙ קֹ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת־ קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים טָה֑וֹר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֹקֵֽחַ׃פ
